confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated but crowdsourced cost-of-living sources (Numbeo via Expatica snapshot of June 2026, LifeIndexed 2026, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, Square bar-price data, and a travel-budget site), so they are rough ranges. Beer, coffee, cocktail and wine anchors are consistent across sources but thinly sourced; wine by the glass has the weakest data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Atlanta metro context. I did not search for or inspect live booking pages or current listings. FX: the RBA page was not opened or verified directly. The 0.6976 rate is from a news report citing the RBA 4pm reference rate for 3 November 2026, and I found no later RBA observation, so the as_of_date may be several weeks before the 19 November generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. The basis is the Atlanta metro, using US restaurant and bar price aggregates and general knowledge of Atlanta lodging prices. Beer, cocktail and wine were checked against each other for consistency, since direct wine data was weak.
